architectureDecision.claim: Recommended best fit for the established teacher purpose and observed constraints, not a measured universal optimum
architectureDecision.selected: One modular TypeScript/Bun teacher application over protected PostgreSQL source versions and attributable teacher revisions; exact direct HTTP source adapters, shared authenticated human/agent query and Action consumers, and supported standard WebMCP as an interaction surface.
architectureDecision.sourceAndStorage: Materialize minimized source evidence and append-only teacher judgments separately. Reuse unchanged versioned content; refresh actual changing assignments/submissions/grades through qualified source operations. Fetch current exact before values again for an admitted official write. Source timestamps are not view time.
architectureDecision.meaning: Preserve owner/student partitions, literal namespaced keys, book edition/major/middle/minor/page/problem hierarchy, paper versus original/clinic attempt, separate upload/grading/written solution/inspection/correction/teacher approval and explicit unknown joins.
architectureDecision.humanAgentParity: Date-first complete observed occurrences and selected-student scenes consume the same TeacherApplication and connection capability result. Agent outputs retain source clocks, scene revisions, unsupported operations and coverage unknowns; no automatic Hermes context injector, second dispatcher or mirrored task store.
architectureDecision.authority: Native Hermes retains lifecycle/configuration/learning/safety. Secure credential ingress is owned by its supported native/secret-source consumer. Teacher judgment/final-value approval and final parent sending remain distinct from read refresh or app uptime.
architectureDecision.officialReflection: Implement only a qualified exact target/field/before/after/approval/recovery/readback executor. Previous-homework assessment targets its prior occurrence, not today's record. Never convert missing tests to score zero or app grades to teacher inspection. Uncertain effects stop before any retry.
architectureDecision.availability: Use the existing owned app/tunnel lifecycle and exact health/readback. Current persistent process recovery is exercised; a new supervisor, scheduler, account, DNS/IAM or reboot guarantee needs its applicable admission and independent evidence.

alternatives.option: Every UI/WebMCP query directly reads the academy
alternatives.reason: Repeats authentication/reads and cannot preserve aged-out source or attributable teacher history; live source freshness and retained explanatory context are different needs.

alternatives.option: Separate human, agent, Sheet and MCP workflows with independent stores
alternatives.reason: Duplicates identity joins, teacher input and revision/approval rules. Keep necessary existing consumers until an accepted transition, not a second operational authority.

alternatives.option: Keep the native browser as a permanent academy authentication broker
alternatives.reason: Conflicts with the user's explicit direct HTTP requirement and refused browser exception; native browser idle/control failures must not become source access workarounds.

alternatives.option: Select a new graph provider or add a workflow platform now
alternatives.reason: Private PostgreSQL and current shared modules already exist. Atomic KG acceptance queries and new privacy/cost/account effects remain separate; new machinery would not fix the missing secure source consumer.
